name: kore-highlight
description: Colorful background highlights behind every token and word. Many palettes, presets and sizing options, plus optional text color, font emphasis and font family.

koreHighlight.enabled.description: Highlight every token with a colored background.

enumDescriptions: Color by token type: keywords, strings, numbers, functions, types, variables, comments.
Colors cycle through the palette across each line.
koreHighlight.mapping.description: How colors are assigned to tokens.

koreHighlight.palette.description: Color palette used for the highlights. 'custom' uses koreHighlight.customPalette.

koreHighlight.customPalette.description: Your own palette as hex colors, e.g. ["#ff6b6b", "#feca57", "#48dbfb"]. Used when palette is 'custom'.

koreHighlight.categoryColors.description: Override single categories (mapping 'category'). Keys: keyword, string, number, function, type, variable, comment. Example: {"keyword": "#ff0066"}.

koreHighlight.singleColor.description: Hex color (#rrggbb) used when mapping is 'single'.

koreHighlight.opacity.description: Opacity of the background highlight. Lower keeps your theme text colors easy to read.

koreHighlight.borderRadius.description: Corner roundness of the highlight in pixels. Does not move text.

koreHighlight.highlightSize.description: Grow the highlight outward by this many pixels (bigger pill). Does not move or resize text.

enumDescriptions: Dark or light text depending on the highlight (needs opacity 0.55 or more).
koreHighlight.textColorMode.description: OPTIONAL: change the text color on highlighted tokens.

koreHighlight.textColor.description: Hex text color used when textColorMode is 'custom'.

koreHighlight.functionStyle.description: OPTIONAL: font emphasis for function names.

koreHighlight.typeStyle.description: OPTIONAL: font emphasis for Types and Classes.

koreHighlight.fontFamily.description: OPTIONAL: font family for highlighted text, e.g. "Fira Code". Empty keeps your editor font. The font must be installed; non-monospace fonts can make the cursor drift slightly.

koreHighlight.excludedLanguages.description: Language IDs that should not be highlighted, e.g. ["markdown"].

koreHighlight.statusBar.description: Show the KoRe-HighLight item in the status bar.
